title: DongCheng Cordless Drill 12 V | 10 mm | 35 N.m Torque | 2 Speed Mode | 2 x Battery | 1 x Charger | 1 x MultiPurpose Drill Bit | 1 x ScrewDriver Bit | 1 x Pair Of Hand Gloves | DCJZ1202 E |
description: The DongCheng DCJZ1202 E is a compact and powerful 12V cordless drill built to handle a wide range of tasks with ease. Powered by a 12V MAX / 2.0Ah lithium-ion battery, it delivers consistent performance and longer runtime, making it ideal for screw driving, wood drilling, metal drilling, and general home and DIY use. The 18+1 torque setting allows precise adjustment for different working conditions, while the 2-speed gearbox (0–400/min and 0–1500/min) lets you switch between high torque for driving screws and high speed for drilling. The 10mm keyless chuck enables quick and secure bit changes without any tools. Weighing just 1.0kg, the rubberised ergonomic body ensures a comfortable grip and reduces user fatigue during extended use. A built-in LED working light improves visibility in dimly lit areas. The package includes a carrying case, the cordless drill, 2 lithium-ion batteries, a charger, a double-ended bit, a multipurpose drill bit, a user manual, and a pair of hand gloves.
